column1: # DECLARED-DARK FDA SOURCES. A source in the extractor's DEFAULT_SOURCES that
# NO install preset requests. Being on this list means the omission is a
# DECISION with a reason, not an oversight.
# THE POINT OF THE FILE: without it, tests/test_every_default_source_is_requested.sh
# leaves only two moves when a source is deliberately withheld -- enable it
# (wrong, see below) or delete the test (worse). A third state lets the
# deferral be declared and dated so the next reader inherits the reason
# instead of re-deriving it, which is what cost a whole PR today.
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Removing a row means the source is now requested
# by a preset. Adding one requires a reason and a condition to remove it.
# RETIRED 2026-09-23: apple_notes. Its row said the converter was absent
# ("vendor/cm024_knowledge ships only base.py + evernote.py adapters"). That
# was TRUE when written and FALSE for months afterwards: the vendored tree now
# ships six adapters including ingestion/adapters/apple_notes.py, the ADAPTERS
# registry maps "apple_notes", and cli.py builds its `--source` choices from
# that map. The row's own removal condition ("`convert --source apple_notes`
# exits 0 on a real apple_notes.json") was MEASURED before the row was
# deleted, not assumed: rc 0 on a synthetic two-note fixture with two markdown
# files written, against a negative control (`--source apple_notes_nope`) that
# exits 2. A declared deferral whose stated condition is met is no longer a
# decision. It is a stale row holding a shipped capability dark, which is
# exactly what this one did for the life of the product.
# source<TAB>reason<TAB>removal condition
apple_music
column2: no consumer anywhere. 0 hits in install.sh, 0 hits in vendor/cm024_knowledge, and `convert --source` is never invoked for it. Extracting it would read the library and hand the data to nothing.
